course.title: JSON and YAML — From Beginner to Professional Practice
course.description: A visual-first, standards-aware curriculum covering JSON and YAML syntax, data models, parsing/serialization, schema validation, APIs, configuration, interoperability, security, testing, and production workflows.
course.category: Data Serialization Formats and Developer Tools
course.version_scope: Standards baseline: RFC 8259 / ECMA-404 for JSON, YAML 1.2.2, JSON Schema 2020-12 examples where declared. Official/source links checked 2026-10-20; verify the target parser, validator, schema dialect, and product docs before publication. YAML parser schemas and optional extensions vary.
prerequisites: No programming experience required. Familiarity with files, folders, and a text editor is helpful. Local parser/validator tools are needed for practical verification.
learning_outcomes: Explain JSON/YAML structure, syntax, and data-model differences.
Create, parse, format, and validate JSON and YAML documents using appropriate tools.
Model nested records and API payloads and author JSON Schema constraints.
Use YAML scalar styles, collections, anchors, aliases, tags, and multi-document streams with compatibility awareness.
Convert and compare formats while documenting type, comment, and formatting loss.
Apply schema validation, security, testing, version control, and production-review practices.
